title: India vs Sri Lanka: Galle crosswinds add a layer of intrigue to contest
content: India's spinners face a challenge adapting to Galle's tricky crosswinds.  The venue's location beside the ocean influences the ball's drift significantly.  Former players believe spinners must adjust quickly to utilise the wind effectively.  Young spinner Manav Suthar's rhythmic action could prove instrumental for India.  Ultimately, harnessing the wind will be crucial for success at Galle.

title: JNU VC says her varsity a beggar, needs Venkateswara temple to raise funds
content: JNU Vice-Chancellor Santishree Dhulipudi Pandit proposed a temple model for institutional funding. She advocated for intellectual pluralism and critiqued academic orthodoxies within universities. Pandit highlighted India's rich civilisational legacy and maritime achievements. She stressed the importance of English alongside Indian languages for national understanding. Pandit cautioned against confining Indian Knowledge Systems to narrow definitions.

title: Months before Google DeepMind exit, Hassabis met Trump officials over AGI safety
content: In a recent discussion, Demis Hassabis proposed establishing an independent safety organization focused on artificial general intelligence. He aims to set clear safety standards and met with key officials, including Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and tech advisor Michael Kratsios. Additionally, he authored an essay advocating for a U.S.-led, industry-funded organization to drive these efforts. This comes amid a surge of activity in AI labs racing toward developing artificial general intelligence.

title: Eye on RSS, Karnataka cabinet clears bill to curb events at public spaces
content: A new bill requires prior government approval for private events on state property.  This legislation aims to regulate gatherings and replace an earlier executive order.  The Karnataka government insists the bill targets no specific organization or political party.  It will apply to all public gatherings, including RSS meetings and route marches.  The bill will be introduced during the ongoing legislative session for enactment.

title: Robot reaches 4,500-year-old sealed barrier inside Egypt’s Great Pyramid
content: A robot explored a hidden passage within Egypt's Great Pyramid of Giza.  It reached a sealed barrier which may be 4,500 years old.  This discovery has renewed questions about the ancient monument's hidden contents.  Researchers used modern technology to examine areas difficult for people to access.  Further study could reveal new details about the pyramid's design and construction.

title: Missouri family wins $214k for 600 acres in 1970 park eminent domain fight
content: In 1970, the Blackwell family’s nearly 600-acre Missouri farm was acquired through eminent domain during the creation of Ozark National Scenic Riverways. The government initially offered $73,000, but after a federal court battle, the family received $214,000. Darrel Blackwell later became a park ranger and longtime canoe rental concessioner.

title: £3.8m superyacht Angiola II sinks off Sardinia after fire, 14 rescued
content: A £3.8million luxury 98ft superyacht, Angiola II, sank off Sardinia just four days after being delivered to its new owner. The vessel reportedly lost buoyancy following an engine failure and fire, leaving 14 people aboard. Twelve were rescued by a nearby boat, while the owner and a friend were taken ashore by a patrol vessel.

title: OpenAI loses another top executive as CRO Denise Dresser resigns
content: Denise Dresser, OpenAI’s Chief Revenue Officer, is resigning after a short tenure. This follows a pattern of notable departures within the organization. In her place, Dali Rajic, who previously worked at Wiz, will step in as the new Chief Revenue Officer. As OpenAI gears up for its potential initial public offering, it has also filed its IPO prospectus with the SEC in secrecy.

title: 'I'd love players to be mobbed like IPL cricketers': Esports eyes mainstream appeal
content: At the Esports World Cup in Paris, chess has emerged as an unlikely test of how far esports can stretch. Mike McCabe explains why the game's centuries-old appeal fits alongside digital titles, what Paris has proved about the EWC's ability to travel, and why its future may depend on creating players with the recognition of IPL stars. His vision points to a broader shift in how esports defines games, audiences and sporting fame.

title: 'Jana Nayagan' box office day 22: Thalapathy Vijay film crosses Rs 320 cr worldwide
content: Thalapathy Vijay's 'Jana Nayagan' has successfully generated sixty-seven lakhs on its twenty-second day since release. With a staggering domestic collection of one hundred ninety-five point zero two crore, and overseas earnings pushing the total gross to three hundred twenty point three four crore, this political action drama directed by H. Vinoth has certainly made its mark, particularly with its Tamil version greatly enhancing daily collections.

title: 'Great competition': Brook takes U-turn, opens door on IPL return amid ban
content: The England white-ball captain said that his priority remains playing for England, but acknowledged the IPL's value in helping players improve.

title: Cruz Beckham looks just like Brooklyn on family yacht as tattoos spark interest
content: Cruz Beckham reunited with his family during their Mediterranean yacht trip in Portofino while showing his tattooed torso. His many family-inspired tattoos have drawn comparisons with older brother Brooklyn Beckham, who remains apart from the family after their public feud. Cruz has previously shown that he still hopes to repair his relationship with Brooklyn despite the ongoing family split.

title: Who was Jessica Bang? Rising golf star dies at 18 after brain hemorrhage
content: In a heartbreaking incident, eighteen-year-old Jessica Bang, an up-and-coming Australian golfer, died in Thailand due to a brain hemorrhage while training for a key tournament. After collapsing and requiring emergency surgery, she sadly passed away. Her family has initiated a fundraiser to cover medical expenses and facilitate her return home. The loss of such a talented athlete has left the Australian golf community in deep sorrow.

title: How Maxx Crosby’s top-25 ranking could change Cowboys’ 2026 trade plans
content: Maxx Crosby landed at No. 24 on the 2026 NFL Top 100, but the Raiders star is still surrounded by trade speculation. With the Cowboys linked to Crosby again after Baltimore's failed offseason deal, here's why his ranking, production and uncertain long-term future in Las Vegas are all drawing attention ahead of the 2026 season as Week 1 approaches quickly.

title: Indian IT sector job market is changing: What can get you hired & at a premium
content: Experts believe that the era of broad-based recruitment and hefty pay hikes in the Indian IT sector is over. Companies are now tightening hiring at the entry level, while at the same time competing to get experienced professionals in select areas.

title: UP polls: How parties are vying for Dalit votes amid Mayawati’s shrinking base
content: A notable evolution in Dalit politics is unfolding in Uttar Pradesh, marked by a decline in the Bahujan Samaj Party's dominance. The Bharatiya Janata Party and the Samajwadi Party are actively courting Dalit voters ahead of elections, and the Congress party is also working to regain its historic connections. Meanwhile, Chandrashekhar Azad is establishing a distinct political identity, foreshadowing a significant shift in the Dalit electoral landscape.

title: 'No clear info': Nepal PM claims Indian territory, but 'loses' 210-year-old treaty papers
content: Nepal's foreign minister announced that the country might have misplaced the original Sugauli Treaty papers, which played a critical role in establishing its borders with British India after the Anglo-Nepalese War. This comes at a time when border disputes with India have intensified. The government plans to systematically assess numerous international agreements, seeking to amend or renew any that are no longer pertinent.

title: She was just 3km from home: B'luru keeps fixing roads, yet they keep turning deadly
content: The tragic accident involving Medha Akarsh underscores the ongoing road infrastructure challenges in Bengaluru. Despite ongoing attempts to repair the extensive pothole issue, the roads are frequently excavated for utility repairs, leading to further damage. This troubling cycle poses daily risks to commuters, emphasizing the urgent need for better coordination and accountability in road maintenance and safety measures.

title: Hours after ban, BCI reverses decision on NALSAR 2026 batch over CJI invite row
content: The Bar Council of India has revised its previous directive concerning NALSAR graduates. Students from NALSAR's 2026 cohort can now pursue enrollment with state bar councils. This update followed significant backlash against the original ruling, which prevented these students from becoming advocates due to their association with a protest. The regulator emphasized that the majority of the students were uninvolved and innocent.

title: The real cost of a govt exam: Years, money, age & a future postponed
content: Students in Ranchi are protesting alleged irregularities in government examinations for 20 days.  Seven students are on hunger strike, with three hospitalized due to failing health.  They demand the chief minister meet them to discuss their concerns directly.  Years of exam delays and age limit issues fuel widespread aspirant frustration across India.  This ongoing uncertainty impacts career choices and mental well-being for many young individuals.

title: Horoscope Today: Daily astrological predictions for August 14
content: Horoscope Today: Read daily horoscope predictions for August 14, 2026. Know all about the astrological events and influences that will be affecting each of the 12 zodiac signs. Our astrologer has analyzed the movements of the planets and the alignment of the stars to bring you the most accurate and up-to-date horoscope predictions for the day ahead. Get ready to discover what the stars have in store for you today.

title: American mom who had daughter at 18 helps her reach dream college 18 years later
content: Against the odds of poverty, Jeanice Perez worked tirelessly to provide her daughter Jordyn with the educational opportunities she never had. Her meticulous savings paved the way for Jordyn's ambitious goal of studying biology at New York University. Jeanice proudly reflects on their strong, nurturing relationship as her most significant achievement, showing that young motherhood can lead to a brilliant future.

title: CAG finds 98% shortfall in Green India Mission forest cover targets, flags lapses
content: The Comptroller and Auditor General raised concerns about the inadequacies within the Green India Mission program, noting that the goal of increasing forest cover was far from realized over a decade. The audit pointed to significant issues in planning and financial oversight, which severely undermined the mission's objectives. Key vulnerable areas were neglected during afforestation, diminishing efforts to combat climate change.

title: Elizabeth Taylor’s former Bel Air estate gets $47m makeover - What is the plan
content: The legendary Bel Air residence of Elizabeth Taylor is undergoing a stunning renovation led by developer Ardie Tavangarian. Aiming to celebrate and retain the actress's memorable essence, the project will merge the original home with an impressive modern addition. Key areas, including Taylor's iconic master bedroom, are being meticulously restored and updated. This remarkable transformation is set for completion next year, promising a breathtaking homage to the star's legacy.

title: Rejuvenating shrinking tanks in Andhra
content: The choking of tanks due to siltation, reduced inflows, and changes in catchment areas in Andhra Pradesh’s Chittoor district, crippled irrigation sources and put farmers in a fix, even as the district administration makes efforts to rejuvenate the water bodies, reports K. Umashankar

title: Dream homes, mounting debts in Telangana
content: Thousands of people await selection under the Indiramma Housing scheme. But for many beneficiaries, the ₹5 lakh subsidy has fallen short of the actual construction cost, forcing them to dip into savings or take loans. With hut-dwellers prioritised under Phase II, the need to contain costs has become more urgent. What is driving construction expenses beyond ₹5 lakh, and what is the Telangana State Housing Corporation doing to address the issue, K. Shiva Shanker finds out

title: Safety not on the platter: Bengaluru’s food safety checks expose gaps, from star hotels to quick-commerce warehouses
content: Food safety inspections over the past few days in Bengaluru have challenged the assumption that a higher-priced meal or a well-known brand, by default, ensures good standards, writes Afshan Yasmeen

title: Omar Abdullah condemns attack on SAD leader Sukhbir Singh Badal
content: “What is shocking is that after Sukhbir survived an attempted assassination attempt in Amritsar earlier, nothing seems to have been done to protect him better,” Mr. Abdullah said

title: Gen Z’s kanwariyas: barefoot and bereft
content: On Haridwar’s holy but littered ghats, people in their 20s– almost all men– arrived in millions. Some had spent a month’s wage to get there; almost all could not afford a room for the night. Those who spoke to Ishita Mishra leaned heavily towards the BJP and believed their parents knew best. Less than a month after the youth protest at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar, at this Hindu religious gathering, where more than half the crowd were Gen Z-ers, the central idea was to conform, to abide by tradition and uphold the system

title: Uttar Pradesh government accelerates disposal of revenue cases
content: “Under Section 24, related to demarcation/measurement, 28,556 cases were pending as of December 31, 2025. From January 1 to July 31, 2026, 91,472 new cases were received, of which 39,645 cases were disposed,” a government statement said

title: Two arrested after Muslim man dies following alleged assault by Kanwariyas
content: Hapur Police have arrested two men, Lokesh and Shivam, in connection with the death of 27-year-old Mohd Azeem, who died from injuries sustained during an alleged assault by kanwariyas following a road accident

title: Bengal government withdraws Banga Bibhusan to BJP MP Nagendra Roy
content: Nagendra Roy was conferred the award in February this year by the Trinamool Congress government. A leader from Cooch Behar was nominated to the Upper House from West Bengal in July 2023 as a candidate backed by the BJP.

title: Contribution of Syama Prasad to be included in school textbooks from next year: Adhikari
content: After the BJP came to power in West Bengal, the new government is going an extra mile to build statues and memorial in the name of Syama Prasad Mookerjee

title: Protect farmers’ rights before pushing cement project: Meghalaya tribal body tells government
content: The authorities in East Jaintia Hills have been unable to hold public hearings following opposition to a ₹1,800-crore integrated cement plant and limestone mining project since May

title: Punjab Assembly polls: BJP’s pro-Sikh strategy gives AAP scope for Hindu outreach
content: With the BJP busy promoting its ‘pro-Sikh’ image and the Congress currently caught up in internal fighting, the AAP is trying to capture a share of the Hindu vote bank in Punjab

title: Truckers call 24-hour strike on Imphal-Silchar highway
content: The stranded truckers say they will extend the strike if their demands for proper food, drinking water, or medical assistance are not met

title: Kerala High Court denies bail to accused in organ trafficking case
content: Organ trafficking exploits vulnerable populations, fuels transnational crime networks, and undermines public trust in legitimate medical systems, says court

title: How family legacy translates into political leadership
content: Reporters sometimes get a chance to see how family reputation and standing translate to political capital over generations

title: Six workers dead, 14 injured as water, debris enter tunnel in Uttarakhand’s Chamoli
content: 22 people were trapped inside the tunnel and 20 were brought out; of them, six were declared dead, while 14 others have sustained injuries and are undergoing treatment; information about the remaining two workers was not immediately available

title: Jharkhand CM Soren urges PM Modi to reconsider mining bill, flags impact on State’s finances
content: In a letter to Mr. Modi, Mr. Soren said mining revenue accounted for 84.9% of the State’s own non-tax revenue in 2024-25, according to the State Economic Survey for 2025-26

title: Supreme Court agrees to take up MP’s plea against use of face-recognition tech on NEET-UG protesters
content: Rajya Sabha Member of Parliament A.A. Rahim said that the use of facial recognition technology and covert surveillance on peaceful protesters was unconstitutional

title: Sumit Sarkar, eminent scholar of modern Indian history, dies at 87
content: His works include Swadeshi Movement in Bengal, 1903-1908 (1973), Modern India (1989), and Writing Social History (1998), among others. He also co-edited Women and Social Reform in Modern India (2007) and Caste in Modern India (2013) with his wife, Tanika Sarkar.

title: Vijay virtually inaugurates infrastructure facilities at SIPCOT complex in Ranipet
content: Officials said the facilities for non-leather companies would meet investors’ requirements to set up new units and aid the welfare of staff; TIDCO has built the facilities under a plug and play model

title: CJI flags ‘misuse’ of live-streamed court proceedings on social media
content: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant says video of proceedings cannot be used for commercial gain, says his reference to ‘cockroaches’ was “misused” and was a “malicious attempt to mislead the youth”

title: As candidates complain, TNPSC starts increasing vacancies to be filled in Group I examination
content: More vacancies are expected to be notified by the TNPSC for the competitive exams once various State government departments decide to fill vacancies

title: Kochi Corporation to recommend Vigilance probe into G. Memorial, P&T complex construction
content: Alleged construction lapses blamed for poor condition of two facilities; UDF councillors raise corruption allegations over G Memorial

title: Mobile phones banned on Kanaka Durga temple premises in Vijayawada
content: New security gate has been installed at the main scanning point to screen devotees entering the temple

title: Depression in Bay to trigger light to moderate rain in A.P.
content: Heavy rainfall is likely at isolated places in Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Parvathipuram-Manyam and Alluri Sitharama Raju districts on Friday

title: 97 MoUs, envisaging over ₹67,542 crore in investment, signed at TVK government’s first investment conclave
content: All these projects are expected to be grounded within six months to one year, says Industries Secretary S. Vijayakumar. Around 25 companies are coming to Tamil Nadu for the first time, points out Deepak Jacob, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Guidance Tamil Nadu

title: Industries sensitised to power market, Indian Energy Exchange in Vijayawada
content: Experts explain procedure for registering on IEX platform, bidding process and the potential benefits of procuring electricity through the exchange

title: CPI firm on Deputy Leader of Opposition post
content: CPI has no objection to convening a meeting of the Left Democratic Front to discuss the issue, says Binoy Viswam

title: India, Bangladesh in talks for an early bilateral visit by PM Rahman to New Delhi
content: Diplomatic sources expressed cautious optimism, saying that 'positive developments' can take place quickly in the coming few days

title: Cybersecurity is an economic imperative for the government: IT Secretary N. Manjula
content: India and Israel share a culture of problem solving, with a strong emphasis on education, entrepreneurship and innovation: Orli Weitzman, Consul General of Israel to South India

title: Food safety crackdown: FDA acts against Domino’s and other eateries
content: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licences of multiple food establishments, including four Domino’s Pizza outlets, as part of an intensified food safety enforcement drive across the state.

title: UPSC agrees in Supreme Court to defer Odisha DGP selection meeting
content: A petition against the Odisha DGP selection process alleges that the process was in violation of the Supreme Court’s Prakash Singh judgment; it also alleges that the Odisha government was trying to include a junior officer, who was given promotion only a day back, in the list of candidates

title: Kudumbashree women entrepreneurs all set to prepare Onasadya
content: The sadya will be supplied by the Kudumbashree entrepreneur in the vicinity of the person placing the order.

title: Chief Minister Revanth Reddy promises better life for urban poor
content: Revanth lays stone for Indiramma Towers in Kukatpally, which envisages affordable housing for poor with four 10-storey towers coming up – each tower having 120 houses with 12 flats on each floor; on the issue of disputes over lands under Section 22, he says no one will lose ownership

title: 11 Injured As Passenger Train Derails In Southern England
content: Aerial footage showed firefighters and paramedics attending to passengers in a field next to the derailed train, with several ambulances and three helicopters standing by.

title: Bar Council's Big Step On Students Opposing Chief Justice, Then A Withdrawal
content: BCI chairperson Manan Kumar Mishra earlier said no student who obtained a law degree from NALSAR in 2026 should be enrolled as an advocate until the council issues further directions.

title: Indian Man In US Faces 20 Years In Jail Over Child Abuse Material
content: An Indian-origin man has pleaded guilty in a federal court in New Jersey to accessing child sexual exploitation material involving a prepubescent minor, the Department of Justice said in a statement.

title: Karnataka Cabinet Approves Public Property Bill Amid RSS Registration Row
content: The Karnataka Cabinet has approved the Karnataka Regulation of Use of Government Premises and Public Property Bill, 2026, Home Minister Priyank Kharge said.

title: Australian PM Says Asked Trump For Tariff Exemption In Phone Call
content: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Friday he had asked US President Donald Trump in a phone call for an exemption from tariffs slapped on his country last month.

title: 7 Arrested As CID Conducts Raids In Jharkhand Exam Scam' Amid Protest
content: The Jharkhand Crime Investigation Department (CID) has conducted raids at multiple locations across the state in connection with alleged irregularities in various competitive examinations conducted by the Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC).

title: World War II Memorial In Washington Vandalised With Bubbles, Graffiti
content: The World War Two memorial in Washington was vandalized with bubbly soap and graffiti on Thursday, prompting vows from the US government to find the perpetrator.

title: 7 Killed, 2 Trapped As Water, Debris Enter Tunnel In Uttarakhand's Chamoli
content: "This is a tunnel under construction for a hydropower project. Around 6.30 pm, a significant amount of debris and water surged into the tunnel," district magistrate Gaurav Kumar said

title: Trump Announces Tariffs Of Up To 100% On Imported Drones To Counter China
content: President Donald Trump announced on Thursday tariffs of up to 100 percent on imports of unmanned drones and their components to reduce US reliance on imports in an industry dominated by China.

title: Akali Dal To Continue "Punjab Bachao" Rallies Despite Attack On Sukhbir Badal
content: The Shiromani Akali Dal has decided to go ahead with its pre scheduled "Punjab Bachao" rallies despite the attack on party president Sukhbir Singh Badal, but there is no word yet on whether Sukhbir himself will lead or address the rallies.

title: Several Homes Burnt, Residents Evacuated As UK Wildfire Intensifies
content: A fire tore through several homes, residents were evacuated and "extensive" damage reported as firefighters battled multiple blazes in central England, which experiencing its hottest day of the year.

title: UAE Says 2 Oil Vessels Hit By Iran In Strait Of Hormuz
content: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company said two of its vessels were attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday evening, with no injuries reported, as the United Arab Emirates accused Iran of carrying out the attack.

title: US Court Dismisses Trump Administration Lawsuit Over Harvard Antisemitism
content: President Donald Trump has launched a campaign against major American universities, accusing them of giving free rein on their campuses to pro-Palestinian movements in the face of the Israeli offensive in the Gaza Strip.

title: Kennedy Center Board Votes To Restore Trump Name On Building: Reports
content: The venue's board of trustees, which is stacked with Trump allies, reportedly voted to approve a workaround by adding the inscription "Restored and Renovated by President Donald J. Trump" to the building.

title: 18 Monuments Delisted From Protected Sites List Since 2021: Centre
content: Bara Khamba Cemetery in Delhi and a banyan grove of "great antiquity" containing traces of ancient buildings are among the 18 sites which have been delisted by the Centre from the list of protected monuments since 2021.

title: IIT Kharagpur 2nd-Year Student Dies After Falling From Hostel Building
content: An engineering student died in an unusual incident at IIT Kharagpur in West Midnapore district on Thursday after reportedly falling from the fourth floor of a campus building.

title: 1991 Jammu Blast Accused Arrested After 35 Years, Was Hiding As Businessman
content: The terrorist has been identified as Altaf Hussain Sheikh, son of Nazir Ahmed Sheikh and a resident of Marhama-Bijbehara in Anantnag. He was living under a fake identity as a businessman in South Kashmir.

title: 'Judiciary Does Not Take Sides, Constitution Supreme': Chief Justice
content: During an interview with DD News, the CJI described the Constitution as the "greatest power" in the nation, noting that safeguarding and strengthening its basic structure remains the decisive role of the judiciary.

title: Secret Trains And Fake Offices: How Russia Hides Putin
content: For years, journalists trying to track Russian President Vladimir Putin have had to look for clues in the strangest places, even the plants in his offices, according to a report by The New York Times.

content: Russian-Japanese relations have long been dogged by the contested islands, known in Japan as the Northern Territories and seized by the Soviet Union in 1945.

title: 'Soon in a trash can': Iran mocks Trump's secret getaway via catering truck
content: a presenter on Iranian state tv described the incident as a new “scandal” for the president . he said it had become a source of humiliation for the US . new details emerged about the security operation during Trump's return from the summit in ankara .

title: Disproportionate assets case: Rahul questions Allahabad HC order, says shift case
content: HC passed the order without reference to any "fundamental material" warranting such a directive . he challenged the validity of the order and questioning its fairness because of 'secret chamber hearing and sealed cover proceedings' he filed another petition seeking transfer of the PIL from the high court to the SC or any other HC .

title: Pak spy arrested in Bengal for ISI links visited Kolkata six times since 2014-15
content: Rana Rouf Khalid, 36, was arrested by the Bengal STF on friday . he had visited at least six times since 2014-15, having spent between one and two months each at topsia . his last visit was in Jan, said an officer .

title: Trump creates task force to crack down on birth tourism, revokes over 600 visas
content: the task force will review the activities of visa holders worldwide, connect information held across federal agencies including the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), examine travel histories and take action against those involved in birth tourism . the move comes amid a wider Trump administration push to prevent what it calls 'birth tourism'

title: UK records hottest day of year as temperature crosses 38°C in west London
content: the provisional reading, recorded by the Met Office, surpassed the previous 2026 high of 38C set on June 28 . it was also the fifth-highest temperature ever recorded in the UK, although it remained below the August record of 38.5C set in 2003 . temperatures reached 38C in pershore, Worcestershire, while 40 locations across central and southern England recorded 36C or higher .

title: SC slams Centre &FSSAI, says you can’t take court for a ride
content: the Supreme Court slammed the Centre and the FSSAI for not implementing its direction on 'front-of-pack warning labels' on processed food packages . the court said their top priority should be the health of citizens and not the interest of multinational companies .

title: US saw most cases of attack on Indians abroad in 2021-25: MEA
content: the govt in parliament tabled figures on the maximum number of attacks on Indians . 33 such attacks were reported from the US from 2021 to 2025 . the UAE saw 32 attacks against Indian nationals in the past five years .

title: Indian officials may join Taliban’s Victory Day celebrations
content: victory day is observed annually by Taliban on august 15 to commemorate the group's return to Kabul in 2021 . the event is not just endorsed by the Indian side but will see participation by senior Indian officials . India doesn't officially recognise the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan .

title: Monsoon Session washed out; INDIA bloc skips customary tea
content: parliament's monsoon session turned out to be all but a washout, more so in terms of debates . BJP blamed leader of the opposition in LS Rahul Gandhi as the house's productivity plunged to a low of 19% .

title: Passenger train derails, flips on side near UK's Lewes; rail routes disrupted
content: a passenger train derailed and flipped to its side near lewes in east Sussex, southern England . no immediate reports of injuries or casualties . a south service came off the tracks in the area shortly before 4 pm BST .

title: ‘Time to move on,’ says HC on Vijay Mallya’s plea against recovery
content: the high court remarked that it was time for a long-pending dispute about recovery from Vijay Mallya, founder of the erstwhile Kingfisher Airlines . a petition against seizures of his assets turned infructuous with seizures and sales over the last six years . justice milind Jadhav sought a reply from the ED to clarify if the civil liabilities have been effective with the recovery of Rs 15,000 crore .

title: Tata Trusts kicks off process to pick Chandrasekaran’s successor
content: Determine the monthly installment amount for a loan Estimate the returns on investments made through SIPs Find out maturity amount and interest earned on PPF Check maturity amount and interest earned on an FD Estimate the pension amount and corpus accumulated under NPS A Mutual Fund Calculator helps estimate the future value of investments

title: TMC gears up to move SC within 10 days to seek disqualification of 20 rebel MPs
content: a disqualification petition will be filed within 10 days, tMC sources say . he had met Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla on Wednesday to reiterate his demand for a speedy decision . banerjee had expressed concern over lack of action so far .

title: SC tells UPSC to defer call on Odisha DGP pick
content: a panel of three officers from which the Odisha govt was to choose the successor of present DGP Y B Khurania, who retires on Aug 16 . the panel of names sent to UPSC was against the DGP selection procedure laid down by SC in the two decade-old Prakash Singh judgement .

title: Consumer forums can’t be mere rehabalitaion centres for retired: SC
content: the consumer dispute redressal commissions cannot be the place for rehabilitation of retired judges and bureaucrats . a pan-India performance evaluation exercise of these quasi-judicial bodies is urgently needed . the plight of consumers denied a hearing for four years has been narrated .

title: SAD chief assailant a law graduate, ran snacks centre in Pune: Police
content: a law graduate, the assailant tried multiple professions in Pune over the years . he had spent most of his life in the city’s Camp area before shifting to the Nanded two years ago for religious service . police inquiries revealed that he practised law for some time, ran a small newspaper and also operated a snacks centre in the Camp area for about three years before shutting it down .

title: BCI bars Nalsar students over CJI Surya Kant protest, retracts
content: the decision follows a campaign by the students againsts the participation of CJI Surya Kant in the convocation ceremony . bar Council of India (BCI) took back its communication hours after issuing it to Hyderabad-based Nalsar University of Law . it said those who organised opposition to the invitation would not be enrolled as advocates .

title: US sends new carrier to Middle East amid reports of mental health crisis on USS Lincoln
content: the carrier swap is part of a previously planned rotation . concerns over crew morale and conditions aboard the Lincoln have raised questions . the move comes as families and lawmakers have raised alarm over reports that sailors have experienced severe burnout and deteriorating living conditions after more than 250 days at sea .

title: Phuket-Delhi A320 lost flight controls for 4 seconds, Airbus preliminary probe finds
content: airbus says the aircraft experienced a sudden loss in altitude that left 24 injured . the aircraft's autopilot was disconnected and the aircraft’s nose went up (increase in pitch) all timings are in IST .

title: 7 dead, 2 missing after water, debris enter under-construction tunnel in U'khand
content: the incident was reported around 7.05pm in the 2km-long Tail Race Tunnel . a landslide caused a cavity to form in an under-construction THDC tunnel . of the 22 workers stranded inside the tunnel, 14 were rescued . search and rescue operations were underway for two missing workers .
